name: Natural Language Grounded Search
title: Natural Language Grounded Search
author: Isaiah DePorto & Gemini
description:
### Natural Language Grounded Search 🧭 (v4.0.0 — Frontier Harness, Quote Recovery & Parent-Steered Multi-Hop)

A streamlined multi-engine retrieval, native multimodal document ingestion, and calibrated `gemini-decision-1` verification plugin engineered for **Gemini Chat Hub** (`node:vm` zero-CORS server runtime) and **Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite / Gemini 4+**.

#### Key v4.0.0 Improvements:
1. **Parent-Steered Search & Conditional Router Bypass:**
   - Optional `adversarialQuery`, `includeDomains`, `excludeDomains`, and `freshness` parameters let Gemini 4 steer dual-angle cross-index retrieval (Exa + Brave RRF) directly, bypassing the internal LLM router on steered, `MINIMAL`, or `documentUrl`-only calls while retaining it for bare queries.
2. **Lean Fact Extraction & `S1..Sn` Handles:**
   - Removes weak-model prescriptive coaching prose (`preferred_action`, `actionability_limit`) in favor of concise premises-first `reconciliation_notes`, deduplicates per-source `sift_audit` metadata, and enforces issued `S1..Sn` handles across SIFT, evidence lattice, extraction, and entailment.
3. **Deterministic Raw-Span Quote Recovery & Combined Admission Gate:**
   - Runs a microsecond raw-span quote-recovery pass against cited sources before gating, then drops non-PDF claims that fail **both** verbatim quote verification and `gemini-decision-1` direct entailment (eliminating soft-flag laundering without over-rejecting valid syntheses).
4. **Parent-Driven Multi-Hop Default (`on_failure_only`):**
   - Defaults internal Hop-2 to catastrophic Hop-1 failure (`>=50%` rejection or zero surviving claims) and surfaces `suggested_followup_axes` + `paywalled_domains` so Gemini 4 orchestrates parallel follow-up searches natively.
5. **Row-Aware Parent Output Cap & Universal `workspace/in/` Spill:**
   - Bounds returned payloads cleanly by mode (`12K`/`24K`/`40K`/`36K` chars) without corrupting JSON or code artifacts, and auto-stages oversized hydrated documents (`>=12K` chars), spreadsheets, and full `RAW_TEXT` corpora to `workspace/in/`.
6. **Gemini 4 Calibration & Nonce-Isolated Untrusted Data:**
   - Calibrates default UCS `thinking_level` to `medium` (`high` in `EXHAUSTIVE`), supports `xhigh` on `gemini-4-hydrogen`/`gemini-4-neon`, and isolates scraped web content inside per-call randomized XML boundary tags.
contextPrompt: When using natural_language_search v4.0.0: sources use S1..Sn handles; check claims[].quote_verified, claims[].quote_match_method, claims[].decision_audit.status, artifacts[].verified_verbatim, sources[].access_status, and control_layer.citation_graph_warnings. sift_audit metrics and overall_epistemic_weight are scaled [0.0, 1.0] (1.0 = highest integrity / cleanest COI); credibility_level is 0=Primary, 1=Secondary, 2=Tertiary. Use retrieval_state.suggested_followup_axes and control_layer.paywalled_domains to decide whether to run targeted follow-up calls. Files in sources[].staged_workspace_files or retrieval_state.staged_raw_evidence_file are ready in workspace in/ for Python/Bash. Bind inline markdown links using the exact cited_sources[].url and title attached to the cited claim.

userSettings.name: generative_model
userSettings.label: Generative Gemini Model ID
userSettings.description: Model ID for extraction and fallback routing (gemini-3.5-flash-lite, gemini-4-hydrogen, gemini-4-carbon, gemini-4-neon, or gemini-4-argon).

userSettings.name: verification_engine
userSettings.label: Verification & SIFT Scoring Engine
userSettings.description: Controls calibrated scoring: hybrid_auto uses Gemini Decision 1 (gemini-decision-1) with generative SIFT fallback; decision_1_calibrated strictly uses Decision 1 with structural heuristic fallback only; generative_fallback skips Decision 1; off uses structural heuristics only.

userSettings.name: enable_hop2_verification
userSettings.label: Hop-2 Iterative Falsification & Gap Loop
userSettings.description: Controls internal Hop-2 search: on_failure_only (default) runs Hop-2 only on heavy entailment rejection so the parent model drives normal multi-hop follow-ups; auto/always_on_gaps trigger internally on tension or gaps.

userSettings.name: search_strategy
userSettings.label: Search Engine Strategy
userSettings.description: Controls Exa + Brave orchestration and RRF: auto routes code/forum primary to Brave and deep/research primary to Exa; hybrid_cross_verify cross-verifies on both engines; prefer_exa / prefer_brave strictly use the preferred engine unless it errors or returns zero results.

userSettings.name: search_api_key
userSettings.label: Exa Search API Key
userSettings.description: Enter your Exa API key or link EXA_API_KEY from Secret Vault.

userSettings.name: brave_api_key
userSettings.label: Brave Search API Key
userSettings.description: Enter your Brave Search API key or link BRAVE_API_KEY from Secret Vault.

userSettings.name: google_api_key
userSettings.label: Google Gemini API Key
userSettings.description: Google Gemini API key for Interactions API and Gemini Decision 1, or link GOOGLE_API_KEY / GEMINI_API_KEY from Secret Vault.

userSettings.name: action_on_error
userSettings.label: Action on Search API Error
userSettings.description: Choose whether to return structured diagnostic JSON to the AI model or throw an immediate UI error on missing keys, search API errors, or UCS synthesis failures.

openaiSpec.name: natural_language_search
openaiSpec.description: Multi-engine grounded web & document search (Exa + Brave RRF), native PDF/spreadsheet hydration, calibrated gemini-decision-1 SIFT provenance scoring, raw-span quote recovery, and entailment gating. Pass optional adversarialQuery, includeDomains, excludeDomains, or freshness to steer dual-angle retrieval directly (bypassing the internal router). Examples: (1) {"query": "Gemini 4 Carbon pricing context window caching specs 2026", "adversarialQuery": "Gemini 4 Carbon caching limitations independent benchmarks", "freshness": "high_freshness"} (2) {"query": "Section 230(c)(1) exact statutory wording", "documentUrl": "https://www.law.cornell.edu/uscode/text/47/230", "outputIntent": "VERBATIM_STATUTE"}

query.description: Specific search objective with exact entities, version/date bounds, technical keywords, or verbatim error strings.

adversarialQuery.description: Optional counterevidence, limitations, or alternative-angle query run in parallel on the complementary search engine (bypasses internal router).

includeDomains.description: Optional domain allowlist (e.g., ["ai.google.dev", "github.com"]) to restrict results.

excludeDomains.description: Optional domains to exclude (e.g., paywalled or low-signal hosts).

freshness.description: Optional temporal freshness hint: breaking (<=7d live crawl), high_freshness (<=48h Exa), standard, timeless, or auto.

detailMode.description: Retrieval depth & output budget: AUTO (default), MINIMAL (fast scalar, skips router), EXHAUSTIVE (broader + high thinking), or RAW_TEXT (spills full corpus to workspace/in/ + top inline windows).

documentUrl.description: Optional direct public http(s) URL to a PDF, spreadsheet (.xlsx/.csv), text, or HTML document.

outputIntent.description: Extraction mode: DEFAULT, VERBATIM_STATUTE (strict verbatim quote/span enforcement), or CODE_BOILERPLATE (preserves raw code artifacts).

contextMetadata.description: Optional environment metadata (e.g., {"dependencyManifest": {"react": "19.0"}}) forwarded to chunk scoring and extraction.
